interactionAxis.storedBaselineSafety: SAFE. ReplayState.computed is z.record(string,string).optional() — an open map, so a wider vocabulary cannot break parsing of an old artifact. compareOpenStateStyle (compare-behavior.ts:362-379) iterates the ORIGINAL side's keys and skips any property the clone side lacks (`actual !== undefined` guard), so a mixed-vocabulary pair degrades to fewer comparisons, never to a false mismatch. Both replay sides are captured live in the same process with the same constant, so no asymmetry arises in practice.

defects.title: comparedProperties === 0 is reported as 'compared' with 0 mismatches
defects.where: src/reconstruction-qa/qa-page.ts — the honest-zero guard tests only `measured.comparedNodes === 0`.
defects.detail: Probed directly: compareQaOnlyStyles over 60 paired nodes whose captured style maps contain none of the 30 QA-only properties returns comparedNodes 60, comparedProperties 0, mismatches 0 — and the wiring then writes qaOnlyStyleComparison:'compared', qaOnlyStyleMismatches:0. compareCapturedStyles routes a property present on only one side into oneSidedProperties and skips it, so a vocabulary drift between the two captures degrades silently toward this state rather than raising it.
defects.impactToday: None observed. Both captures go through runCapture with styleProperties = QA_STYLE_PROPERTIES, of which QA_ONLY is a verified subset, so comparedProperties is > 0 whenever any element compares. The integration section asserts comparedProperties > 0 on a real run.
defects.mitigation: worstPages already prints '<n> of <m>' with m = comparedProperties, so a 0-of-0 page is visible in the per-page detail. The CLI headline is the weaker surface: it prints compared PAIRS, not compared properties, so a site-wide 0-of-0 would read as a clean 0.
defects.suggestedFix: Extend the guard to `measured.comparedNodes === 0 || measured.comparedProperties === 0` with a fifth reason (e.g. no-comparable-properties), or surface a comparedProperties denominator in LiveFidelity.

notes: Verdict is PASS_WITH_RISKS solely because of D1, which is a latent honesty gap rather than an observed wrong number. Everything the handoff claims about changes A, B and C reproduced exactly.

The mutation test is the decisive evidence and it came back the right way: unwiring the single call reduced smoke-qa-independence from 101 to 92, and the file was restored to the identical sha256 (a15be9bd...) with the suite back at 101/101.

The claim that the pairing is REUSED rather than invented is accurate. compareQaOnlyStyles introduces no matching logic at all: it looks both maps up by SiteSpec nodeId, re-keys the records onto that shared id (the only transformation), and delegates to compareCapturedStyles. The rekeying is genuinely necessary — the original side's element.key is a document-order index while the clone side's is a node id.
Historical compatibility is stronger than claimed: 96 page results and 62 summaries across six sites parse under the current schemas, all with the new fields absent.
